name: cn-ecommerce-listing
description: Write a product listing for a Chinese consumer marketplace (淘宝, 天猫, 拼多多 or 京东): a keyword-built title within the platform's length limit, selling points, main image and detail page copy, SKU naming, category attributes, and a check against advertising-law banned words. Use when asked 帮我写淘宝标题, 写商品详情页, 拼多多标题怎么写, 京东商品卖点, 主图文案, or optimise my Taobao listing. Produces three title options with the keyword logic, five selling points, copy for five main images, a detail page outline, SKU names, attributes to fill in and a compliance check. Distinct from marketplace-listing-optimizer (Amazon and Western marketplaces) and cross-border-listing (selling abroad).
